metadata.objective: Remove excessive console logging while preserving critical error handling and debugging capabilities

estimated_impact.performance: Reduced JavaScript execution overhead in production
estimated_impact.bundle_size: Minimal reduction through dead code elimination

executive_summary.issue: Excessive console logging throughout the frontend codebase creates noise in development and production environments, hampering debugging and potentially impacting performance.

action.description: Remove frequent isAdmin derived store logging (called on every reactive update)
action.impact: Eliminates 100+ logs per session from reactive checking

action.description: Replace authentication flow logging with conditional DEBUG logging
Remove verbose checkAuth and setUser method logging
action.impact: Eliminates authentication noise while preserving error handling

action.description: Keep critical error logging for authentication failures and validation errors
Replace debug logging in auth callback and login pages with conditional DEV logging
Keep error logging for OAuth failures and critical auth errors
Remove routine state logging in protected layout

pattern.solution: Replace with conditional DEV logging for request/response details

pattern.description: Keep critical error logging for API failures
pattern.rationale: Essential for diagnosing API connectivity and authentication issues

pattern.description: Convert performance warnings to conditional logging
pattern.solution: Keep in DEV mode, remove in production

phase.name: Phase 5: Infrastructure and Utility Cleanup
phase.scope: Build scripts, utilities, and configuration files

action.description: Update vite.config.ts proxy logging to be development-only

debug_logging.rule: Use conditional logging for development debugging: if (import.meta.env.DEV) console.log(...)
Remove any console.log statements used for temporary debugging
Keep structured debug logging for complex authentication flows (in DEV only)

error_logging.rule: Always preserve console.error for critical failures (authentication, API errors, validation failures)
Keep console.warn for important but non-critical issues (missing optional data, fallback scenarios)
Remove console.warn for routine validation messages

performance_logging.rule: Remove console.log from frequently called functions (reactive stores, derived values)
Remove API request/response logging unless flagged as development-only
Keep performance warnings only in development mode

validation_steps.step: Run all existing tests to ensure no critical functionality is broken
Test authentication flows in both development and production builds
Verify error handling still logs appropriately for debugging
Check that performance-critical paths (isAdmin checks) no longer spam console
Validate that development debugging capabilities are preserved with DEV flag

regression_prevention.eslint_rule: Add ESLint rule to prevent new console.log statements in production code
regression_prevention.typescript_utility: Create typed debug utilities to enforce consistent logging practices
regression_prevention.pre_commit_hook: Add pre-commit hook to check for console.log statements

rollback_plan.backup_strategy: Create backup of all modified files before cleanup
rollback_plan.phased_rollback: Each phase can be rolled back independently if issues arise
rollback_plan.critical_paths: Authentication and API error handling have highest priority for preservation

quantitative.metric: Reduce console statements in auth.store.ts from 63 to <15
Eliminate 90%+ of debug logging from service layer
Reduce total console calls per session from 500+ to <50

qualitative.metric: Preserved debugging capabilities for critical issues
Better separation between debug logging and error handling

timeline.testing_buffer: Additional 2-3 hours for testing and validation
